answers.core: While it is theoretically possible to access the debug console with plugins, it is difficult to do so. While this is a feature that would be used infrequently (ideally not at all), it would be much easier to implement inside the engine core than inside a plugin.
answers.workaround: There is currently no way to block a specific message in the console, and implementing such a feature would be a much more in-depth effort than a few lines of script.

title: Add editor option to suppress specific error messages
